div.l: Tales of best sentence · ⁊and of moost solas ·
Schall haue a soper · at oure alther coste ·
Here in this place . sittyng bi this poste ·
Whan that we comen a geyn · fro Caūntirbury ·
And for to make you . the more mery ·
I woll my self · goodly witħ you ryde ·
Right at myn owne coste . ⁊and be your gyde
And who so wole · my iugement witħseie ·
Schaƚƚ paie for aƚƚ · we spende by the weie
And if ye vouchesauf · that it be so ·
Teƚƚ me a noon · witħoute wordis mo ·
And I woll erli · schape me ther fore ·
This thyng was graūntid · ⁊and oure othes swore ·
Witħ full glad herte · ⁊and prayen hym also ·
That he wolde vouchesauf · for to done so ·
And he wolde ben · our gouernour ·
And of oure tales · iuge ⁊and reportour ·
And sette a soper · at a certeyn pris ·
And we woll rewled ben · at his deuys ·
In higħ ⁊and lowe · ⁊and thus bi oon assent ·
We ben accorded · to the iugement ·
And ther vpon · the wyne was fet a non̄ ·
We dronke · ⁊and to reste wente echon̄ ·
With oute eny · lenger tariyng ·
A morow · whan the daie began to spryng ·
Vp ros oure host · ⁊and was oure alther cok ·
And gederid vs · to gedir in a flok ·
And fortħ we riden · a litell more than a pas ·
Vn to the wateryng · of seynt Thomas ·
And than oure host · gan his hors a reste ·
And seide lordynges · herkenytħ if you leste ·
Ye wote youre forward · ⁊and I it recorde ·
Yf euynsong · ⁊and morow song accorde ·
Lat se now · who schall telle the first tale ·
As euyr mote I · drynke wyne or ale ·
Who so be rebell · to my iugement ·
Schaƚƚ paye for all · that bi the weye is spent ·
Now drawetħ cut · or that we ferther twynne ·
Whiche that hatħ the schortist · schaƚƚ first bigynne ·
¶ Sir knyght qduod he · my maister ⁊and my lorde ·
Now drawetħ cut · for that is myn accorde ·
Cometħ ner qduod he · my lady priores ·
And sire Clerk · lat be your schamefastnes ·
Ne studietħ nougħt · leye honde to eueri man ·
A noon to drawe · euery wigħt began ·
And schortly for to tellen · as it was ·
Were it bi auenture · or sort or cas ·Deess͒um foliu
